title: Man shot and killed by police in Forest Lawn
article: Alberta's police watchdog is investigating after a man was killed in an officer-involved shooting Saturday afternoon.
Police responded to reports of a man believed to be carrying weapons near 45 Street and 17 Avenue southeast.
Witnesses told police the man assaulted a bystander and was threatening others.
Calgary police say in a statement that officers attempted to negotiate with the suspect. They claim he had weapons on him, though did not provide any details as to what they were.
An officer-involved shooting has occurred in Forest Lawn. Details below. pic.twitter.com/x7IxR5sePm
Police say despite their de-escalation efforts, officers ended up shooting the man because of his actions. CPS would not comment on what de-escalation tactics were used.
The man was declared dead at the scene despite life-saving efforts.
CPS says a police dog was hurt by the suspect.
The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team is now investigating.
Roads have been shut down after the incident and drivers are being asked to avoid the area.
